text:
morgan: Quick sync — planning a small private-beta (VPC / on-prem) cohort, aiming for 8-10 design partners over the next 4 weeks. Need to lock acceptance criteria, incentive package, NDA cadence, and minimal infra requirements. Spreadsheet with candidate list: https://redwood.app/sheets/private-beta (WIP)

devon: +1. Can we guarantee Dedicated capacity for each partner? thinking 2 GPU nodes reserved per customer to avoid noisy neighbor during onboarding. Also we should set a launch gating SLO: p95 latency <200ms for 512 tokens.

anya: For feedback loop: weekly async feedback form + one 30m interview every 2 weeks. Also require partners to run the supplied eval harness so we can capture regressions: `tools/eval/run.sh --suite=priv-beta-v1`. We'll attach a seed prompt set (privacy-sla-100) for quality checks.

sam: Integration checklist proposal: 1) confirm VPC peering & routes, 2) KMS configured and tested, 3) audit-logs enabled and shipped to their SIEM. e2e smoke test commands for onboarding: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-v1", "prompt":"hello"}'
``` run this after peering config.

nate: Legal note — need NDA signed before sharing private image and DPA for customer data handling. Incentive model: $5k platform credits + 4 hours of dedicated onboarding support + monthly credits for feedback milestones. Prefer milestone-based payouts: 25% after onboarding, 50% after 4 weeks of active feedback, 25% at graduation.

oncall-bot: Reminder: capacity-provision job started for cohort 2026-04-12. JobID: cp-5001.

morgan: Nice—capturing action items. Proposed owners: devon => capacity & SLOs, sam => integration checklist & smoke test, anya => feedback forms + eval harness, nate => legal & incentives. I'll update the spreadsheet and ping potential partners. Anyone object to weekly async form cadence? :eyes:

devon: fine by me. Also recommend a canary fallback plan: if p95 >300ms, route to hosted API variant automatically.

anya: yes please add canary fallback and a prompt-level regression alert tied to the eval harness.

nate: I'll draft NDA + milestone contract template and share by EOD tomorrow.

morgan: Perfect. I'll slot onboarding calendar: week1 network & KMS, week2 model integration & smoke tests, week3 feedback interviews + eval runs, week4 tuning + graduation. Adding owners to spreadsheet now. Thanks all :thumbsup:
